remarks: Welcome to this spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in the desirable Kingswood condominium community, offering the perfect blend of privacy, convenience, and commuter-friendly living. Ideally located near the Merritt 7 train station, the Norwalk River Valley Trail, shopping, dining, and major highways, this home makes everyday living effortless. The main level features an inviting living room with a cozy fireplace, a dining area ideal for entertaining, and a functional layout that flows comfortably throughout. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, each offering comfort and ample closet space, along with two full bathrooms. The lower level provides exceptional versatility with interior access from the built-in garage and a flexible room-perfect for a home office, fitness area, hobby room, or additional storage. Step outside to the private walk-out patio, an ideal spot to relax or enjoy outdoor dining. Whether you're a first-time home owner, downsizing, or looking for a convenient commuter location, this well-maintained townhouse offers comfort, flexibility, and an outstanding location.
